title: Bioequivalency Study of 300 mg Lithium Carbonate Under Fasting Conditions
brief_summary: The objective of this study was the bioequivalence of a Roxane lithium carbonate 300 mg extended release tablet formulation compared to Solvay's Lithobid 300 mg extended release tablet under fasting conditions using a single-dose, randomized, 2 treatment, 2-period, 2-sequence crossover design.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* No clinically significant abnormal findings on the physical examination, medical history, or clinical laboratory results during screening.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Positive test for HIV, Hepatitis B, or Hepatitis C.
* Treatment with known enzyme altering drugs.
* History of allergic or adverse response to lithium, or any comparable or similar product.
